article.title: Udoaka-Essien joins APC; more senators may follow
article.text: Senator Ifiok Udoaka-Essien of Akwa Ibom Demo District 1 on Monday joined the All Progressives Congress. "I have left the PDP and joined the APC," Udoaka-Essien said in Uyo. Party sources said two other senators from the South-South are in talks with the APC and may move before the end of the month.
